instructions.name: burn
docs: Burns a compressed NFT leaf, permanently removing it from the tree.
The caller must be the leaf owner or delegate. The leaf's current state
(root, dataHash, creatorHash, nonce, index) plus a Merkle proof passed
as remaining accounts are required to prove the leaf exists before it
is replaced with an empty node.

docs: Delegate authority for the leaf; defaults to the leaf owner when no

collection, a permanent burn delegate plugin on that collection.

instructions.name: createTree
docs: Creates a new empty Merkle tree for storing compressed (V1) NFTs.
Initializes both the underlying concurrent Merkle tree account and its
`TreeConfig` PDA. `maxDepth` and `maxBufferSize` are fixed for the life
of the tree and bound its maximum leaf capacity and the number of
concurrent modifications it can support.

leaves it can hold. Fixed for the lifetime of the tree.

`mintV2` and the other `*V2` instructions.

instructions.name: mintV2
docs: Mints a new asset using `LeafSchema` V2 and optionally adds it to an
MPL Core collection. Requires a tree created with `createTreeV2`.
`LeafSchema` V2 enables new functionality over V1 minting:
1. Uses MPL Core collections instead of Token Metadata collections.
2. Uses the streamlined `MetadataArgsV2` arguments, which eliminate
the collection verified flag: any collection included is
automatically considered verified.
3. Allows plugins such as Royalties or Permanent Burn Delegate on the
MPL Core collection to authorize operations on the Bubblegum
asset. The `BubblegumV2` plugin must also be present on the MPL
Core collection for it to be usable with Bubblegum.
4. Allows freezing/thawing of the asset, as well as marking it
permanently non-transferable (soulbound).

definedTypes.name: creator
docs: A single creator entry in a compressed NFT's metadata.

fields.name: address
docs: Public key of the creator.

fields.name: verified
docs: Whether this creator has signed to verify their share.

fields.name: share
docs: The creator's royalty share of the asset.
The value is a percentage (0-100), not basis points.

definedTypes.name: uses
docs: Consumable-use configuration for an asset (e.g. tickets or
redeemable passes), tracking how it may be used and how many uses
remain.

fields.name: useMethod
docs: How the remaining uses are consumed.

fields.name: remaining
docs: Number of uses left.

fields.name: total
docs: Total number of uses the asset was minted with.

definedTypes.name: collection
docs: A collection reference on a V1 leaf's metadata, with its own
verified flag independent of the collection's on-chain verification
state.

fields.name: verified
docs: Whether the collection has been verified via `verifyCollection` / `setAndVerifyCollection`.

fields.name: key
docs: Mint of the collection NFT.

definedTypes.name: metadataArgs
docs: Metadata for a V1 (`LeafSchema` V1) compressed NFT leaf.
Mirrors the fields of a Token Metadata `Metadata` account closely
enough that a leaf can be decompressed into one. Hashed (along with
`creators`) to produce the `dataHash`/`creatorHash` used to verify
the leaf on every mutating instruction.

fields.name: name
docs: The name of the asset

fields.name: symbol
docs: The symbol for the asset

fields.name: uri
docs: URI pointing to JSON representing the asset

fields.name: sellerFeeBasisPoints
docs: Royalty basis points that goes to creators in secondary sales (0-10000)

fields.name: primarySaleHappened
docs: Immutable, once flipped, all sales of this metadata are considered secondary.

fields.name: isMutable
docs: Whether or not the data struct is mutable, default is not

fields.name: editionNonce
docs: nonce for easy calculation of editions, if present

fields.name: tokenStandard
docs: Token standard.  Currently only `NonFungible` is allowed.

fields.name: collection
docs: Collection

fields.name: uses
docs: Uses

fields.name: tokenProgramVersion
docs: Which SPL token program a decompressed version of this leaf's mint should use.

fields.name: creators
docs: Creators of the asset and their royalty shares; hashed to produce `creatorHash`.

definedTypes.name: metadataArgsV2
docs: Metadata for a `LeafSchema` V2 compressed NFT leaf.
Streamlined relative to `MetadataArgs`: it drops `editionNonce` and
`uses`, and its `collection` is a plain, always-verified `Pubkey`
rather than a `Collection` struct with a separate verified flag.

fields.name: name
docs: The name of the asset

fields.name: symbol
docs: The symbol for the asset

fields.name: uri
docs: URI pointing to JSON representing the asset

fields.name: sellerFeeBasisPoints
docs: Royalty basis points that goes to creators in secondary sales (0-10000)

fields.name: primarySaleHappened
docs: Immutable, once flipped, all sales of this metadata are considered secondary.

fields.name: isMutable
docs: Whether or not the data struct is mutable, default is not

fields.name: tokenStandard
docs: Token standard.  Currently only `NonFungible` is allowed.

fields.name: creators
docs: Creator array

fields.name: collection
docs: Collection.  Note in V2 its just a `Pubkey` and is always considered verified.

definedTypes.name: updateArgs
docs: Metadata fields to change on a leaf via `updateMetadata` /
`updateMetadataV2`. Every field is optional; omitted fields keep
their current value.

fields.name: name
docs: New name for the asset, or unset to keep the current name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: New symbol for the asset, or unset to keep the current symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: New metadata URI for the asset, or unset to keep the current URI.

fields.name: creators
docs: New creators array for the asset, or unset to keep the current creators.

fields.name: sellerFeeBasisPoints
docs: New royalty basis points, or unset to keep the current value.

fields.name: primarySaleHappened
docs: New primary sale flag, or unset to keep the current value.

fields.name: isMutable
docs: New mutability flag, or unset to keep the current value.

definedTypes.name: version
docs: Schema version of a tree's leaves: `V1` (Token Metadata
collections) or `V2` (MPL Core collections, freezing, and
non-transferable assets).

definedTypes.name: leafSchema
docs: The canonical on-chain representation of a compressed NFT leaf,
hashed to produce the value stored at a tree's leaf node.
`V1` is produced by `mintV1`/`mintToCollectionV1` and the legacy
instruction family; `V2` is produced by `mintV2` and adds
`collectionHash`, `assetDataHash` and `flags` to support MPL Core
collections and freezing/non-transferable assets.

fields.name: id
docs: Asset id of the leaf, derived from the tree address and `nonce`.

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner of the leaf.

fields.name: delegate
docs: Current delegate of the leaf (equal to `owner` when unset).

fields.name: nonce
docs: Tree-scoped nonce assigned to the leaf when it was minted; part of the asset id derivation.

fields.name: dataHash
docs: Keccak256 hash of the leaf's metadata (`MetadataArgs`/`MetadataArgsV2`).

fields.name: creatorHash
docs: Keccak256 hash of the leaf's creators array.

definedTypes.name: useMethod

docs: Discriminator for events Bubblegum logs via the noop program, read

definedTypes.name: decompressibleState

logged event, read back by off-chain indexers.

docs: A single obligation order.
See [Obligation::orders].

fields.name: conditionThresholdSf
docs: A threshold value used by the condition (scaled [Fraction]).
The exact meaning depends on the specific [Self::condition_type].
Examples:
- when `condition_type == 2 (UserLtvBelow)`:
then a value of `0.455` here means that the order is active only when the obligation's
user LTV is less than `0.455` (i.e. < 45.5%).
- when `condition_type == 3 (DebtCollPriceRatioAbove)`:
assuming the obligation uses BTC collateral for SOL debt, then a value of `491.3` here
means that the order is active only when the BTC-SOL price is greater than `491.3` (i.e.
> 491.3 SOL per BTC).

fields.name: opportunityParameterSf
docs: A configuration parameter used by the opportunity (scaled [Fraction]).
The exact meaning depends on the specific [Self::opportunity_type].
Examples:
- when `opportunity_type == 0 (DeleverageSingleDebtAmount)`:
Assuming the obligation uses BTC collateral for SOL debt, then a value of `1_234_000_000`
here means that a liquidator may repay up to 1234000000 lamports (i.e. 1.234 SOL) on this
obligation.
Note: the special value of [Fraction::MAX] is *not* allowed in this case.
- when `opportunity_type == 1 (DeleverageAllDebtAmount)`:
The only allowed value in this case is [Fraction::MAX] (to emphasize that *all* debt
should be repaid).

fields.name: minExecutionBonusBps
docs: A *minimum* additional fraction of collateral transferred to the liquidator, in bps.
The minimum bonus is applied exactly when the [Self::condition_threshold_sf] is met, and
grows linearly towards the [Self::max_execution_bonus_bps].
Example: a value of `50` here means 50bps == 0.5% bonus for an "LTV > 65%" order, when
executed precisely at the moment LTV exceeds 65%.

fields.name: maxExecutionBonusBps
docs: A *maximum* additional fraction of collateral transferred to the liquidator, in bps.
The maximum bonus is applied at the relevant "extreme" state of the obligation, i.e.:
- for a stop-loss condition, it is a point at which the obligation becomes liquidatable;
- for a take-profit condition, it is a point at which obligation has 0% LTV.
In non-extreme states, the actual bonus value is interpolated linearly, starting from
[Self::min_execution_bonus_bps] (at the point specified by the order's condition).
Example: a value of `300` here means 300bps == 3.0% bonus for a "debt/coll price > 140"
order, when executed at a higher price = 200, at which the obligation's LTV happens to
be equal to its liquidation LTV.

fields.name: conditionType
docs: Serialized [ConditionType].
The entire order is void when this is zeroed (i.e. representing [ConditionType::Never]).
Example: a value of `2` here denotes `UserLtvBelow` condition type. Of course, to
interpret this condition, we also need to take the [Self::condition_threshold_sf] into
account.

fields.name: opportunityType
docs: Serialized [OpportunityType].
Example: a value of `0` here denotes `DeleverageSingleDebtAmount` opportunity. Of course, to
interpret this opportunity, we also need to take the [Self::opportunity_parameter_sf] into
account.

fields.name: padding1
docs: Internal padding.
The fields above take up 2+2+1+1 bytes = 48 bits, which means we need 80 bits = 10 bytes to
align with `u128`s.

fields.name: padding2
docs: End padding.
The total size of a single instance is 8*u128 = 128 bytes.

account.

align with `u128`s.

accounts.name: pluginHeaderV1
docs: Marker account data written after an asset/collection's core
fields once it has at least one plugin, pointing to the
`PluginRegistryV1` that follows.

docs: Account discriminator; always `Key.PluginHeaderV1`.

fields.name: pluginRegistryOffset
docs: The byte offset, within the asset/collection account, at
which the `PluginRegistryV1` data begins.

accounts.name: pluginRegistryV1
docs: The index of every internal plugin and external plugin adapter
attached to an asset or collection, stored after the
`PluginHeaderV1`.

fields.name: key
docs: Account discriminator; always `Key.PluginRegistryV1`.

fields.name: registry
docs: The internal plugins attached to the asset/collection, and where each one's data lives.

fields.name: externalRegistry
docs: The external plugin adapters attached to the asset/collection,
and where each one's data lives.

accounts.name: assetV1
docs: An MPL Core asset: a single account holding an NFT's owner,
update authority, name, URI and sequence number, with its
plugins stored afterward in the same account.

fields.name: key
docs: Account discriminator; always `Key.AssetV1`.

fields.name: owner
docs: The current owner of the asset.

fields.name: updateAuthority
docs: The authority allowed to update the asset's metadata and plugins.

fields.name: name
docs: The asset's display name.

fields.name: uri
docs: The URI pointing to the asset's off-chain JSON metadata.

fields.name: seq
docs: Sequence number incremented on certain mutations (e.g.
`executeV1`); present once the asset has been touched by such
an instruction, used to detect stale off-chain indexes.

accounts.name: collectionV1
docs: An MPL Core collection: a single account grouping assets under
a shared update authority, with collection-level plugins
stored afterward in the same account.

fields.name: key
docs: Account discriminator; always `Key.CollectionV1`.

fields.name: updateAuthority
docs: The authority allowed to update the collection and manage its plugins.

fields.name: name
docs: The collection's display name.

fields.name: uri
docs: The URI pointing to the collection's off-chain JSON metadata.

fields.name: numMinted
docs: The total number of assets ever minted into this collection.

fields.name: currentSize
docs: The number of assets currently belonging to this collection.

accounts.name: groupV1
docs: An MPL Core group: a single account organizing assets,
collections and other groups under a shared update authority,
independent of the collection hierarchy.

fields.name: key
docs: Account discriminator; always `Key.GroupV1`.

fields.name: updateAuthority
docs: The authority allowed to update the group and manage its membership.

fields.name: name
docs: The group's display name.

fields.name: uri
docs: The URI pointing to the group's off-chain JSON metadata.

fields.name: collections
docs: The addresses of the collections that are direct members of this group.

fields.name: groups
docs: The addresses of the child groups nested under this group.

fields.name: parentGroups
docs: The addresses of the groups that this group is itself a member of.

fields.name: assets
docs: The addresses of the assets that are direct members of this group.

accounts.name: hashedAssetV1
docs: The compressed (`LedgerState`) representation of an asset:
just a discriminator and a hash committing to its full data,
restorable via `decompressV1`.

fields.name: key
docs: Account discriminator; always `Key.HashedAssetV1`.

docs: The 32-byte hash committing to the asset's full data and
plugin state while compressed.

instructions.name: createV1
docs: Creates a new Core asset — a single Solana account holding an
NFT's owner, update authority, name, URI and plugins, with no
separate mint, token account or metadata account.
The asset account is a freshly generated keypair (not a PDA). If
`collection` is provided, the asset is minted into that
collection and inherits its collection-level plugins.

accounts.name: collection

accounts.name: authority
docs: The authority signing for creation

accounts.name: payer
docs: The account paying for the storage fees

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner of the new asset. Defaults to the authority if not present.

accounts.name: updateAuthority
docs: The authority on the new asset

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: The system program

accounts.name: logWrapper
docs: The SPL Noop Program

arguments.name: createV1Args
docs: The asset's initial data state, name, URI and plugins.

instructions.name: createCollectionV1
docs: Creates a new Core collection — a single account that groups
assets under a shared update authority and collection-level
plugins (e.g. shared royalties).
Like assets, collections are keypair-generated accounts rather
than PDAs.

instructions.name: executeV1

signed by the asset's own program-derived `assetSigner`
address.
This lets an asset act as its own transaction signer (e.g. to
control a wallet or vault it owns). Requires the owner or an
authorized delegate, and increments the asset's sequence
number. Not available for compressed assets.

organize assets, collections and other groups under a shared
update authority, independent of (and orthogonal to) the
collection hierarchy.

accounts.name: group
docs: The address of the new group

accounts.name: updateAuthority
docs: The authority of the new group

accounts.name: payer
docs: The account paying for the storage fees

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: The system program

arguments.name: createGroupV1Args
docs: The group's name, URI and initial member relationships.

instructions.name: closeGroupV1
docs: Closes an empty group account and refunds its rent to `payer`.

accounts.name: group
docs: The address of the group to close

accounts.name: payer
docs: The account receiving reclaimed lamports

accounts.name: authority
docs: The update authority of the group

arguments.name: closeGroupV1Args
docs: Reserved for future use; currently carries no data.

instructions.name: updateGroupV1
docs: Updates a group's name, URI and/or update authority.

accounts.name: group
docs: The address of the group to update

accounts.name: payer
docs: The account paying for the storage fees

accounts.name: authority
docs: The update authority of the group

accounts.name: newUpdateAuthority
docs: The new update authority of the group

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: The system program

arguments.name: updateGroupV1Args
docs: The fields to change; omitted fields are left untouched.

instructions.name: createOrUpdate
docs: Creates or updates a RuleSet stored in a program-derived account.
A RuleSet is a named, versioned collection of authorization rules
owned by its creator. Each call appends a new revision to the PDA;
existing revisions are preserved so previously-signed operations
remain reproducible. Pass a serialized RuleSet built with the
auth-rules Rust/JS SDK.

docs: Payer and creator of the RuleSet

docs: The PDA account where the RuleSet is stored

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program

accounts.name: bufferPda
docs: The buffer to copy a complete ruleset from

arguments.name: createOrUpdateArgs
docs: The (versioned) CBOR-serialized RuleSet to store.

instructions.name: validate
docs: Validates an operation against a stored RuleSet.
Normally invoked via CPI by another program (e.g. Token Metadata)
to decide whether a token operation is permitted. Returns an error
if any rule for the operation fails. When `updateRuleState` is set,
stateful rules such as Frequency are advanced and persisted to the
rule-set state PDA.

arguments.name: validateArgs

instructions.name: writeToBuffer
docs: Appends serialized RuleSet bytes to a buffer PDA.
RuleSets larger than a single transaction can hold are streamed in
chunks to a buffer account, then applied in one `createOrUpdate`
call that reads from the buffer.

instructions.name: puffRuleSet
docs: Grows a RuleSet PDA by reallocating additional space.
Used to pre-allocate ("puff up") the account to the size a large
RuleSet will need before writing to it, since a single instruction
can only grow an account by a limited amount.

accounts.name: stakePool
docs: Initialized program details.

fields.name: accountType
docs: Account type, must be `StakePool` currently

fields.name: manager
docs: Manager authority, allows for updating the staker, manager, and fee
account

fields.name: staker
docs: Staker authority, allows for adding and removing validators, and
managing stake distribution

fields.name: stakeDepositAuthority
docs: Stake deposit authority
If a depositor pubkey is specified on initialization, then deposits must
be signed by this authority. If no deposit authority is specified,
then the stake pool will default to the result of:
`Pubkey::find_program_address(
&[&stake_pool_address.as_ref(), b"deposit"],
program_id,

fields.name: stakeWithdrawBumpSeed
docs: Stake withdrawal authority bump seed
for `create_program_address(&[state::StakePool account, "withdrawal"])`

fields.name: validatorList
docs: Validator stake list storage account

fields.name: reserveStake
docs: Reserve stake account, holds deactivated stake

fields.name: poolMint
docs: Pool Mint

fields.name: managerFeeAccount
docs: Manager fee account

fields.name: tokenProgramId
docs: Pool token program id

fields.name: totalLamports
docs: Total stake under management.
Note that if `last_update_epoch` does not match the current epoch then
this field may not be accurate

fields.name: poolTokenSupply
docs: Total supply of pool tokens (should always match the supply in the Pool
Mint)

fields.name: lastUpdateEpoch
docs: Last epoch the `total_lamports` field was updated

fields.name: lockup
docs: Lockup that all stakes in the pool must have

fields.name: epochFee
docs: Fee taken as a proportion of rewards each epoch

fields.name: nextEpochFee
docs: Fee for next epoch

fields.name: preferredDepositValidatorVoteAddress
docs: Preferred deposit validator vote account pubkey

fields.name: preferredWithdrawValidatorVoteAddress
docs: Preferred withdraw validator vote account pubkey

fields.name: stakeDepositFee
docs: Fee assessed on stake deposits

fields.name: stakeWithdrawalFee
docs: Fee assessed on withdrawals

fields.name: nextStakeWithdrawalFee
docs: Future stake withdrawal fee, to be set for the following epoch

fields.name: stakeReferralFee
docs: Fees paid out to referrers on referred stake deposits.
Expressed as a percentage (0 - 100) of deposit fees.
i.e. `stake_deposit_fee`% of stake deposited is collected as deposit
fees for every deposit and `stake_referral_fee`% of the collected
stake deposit fees is paid out to the referrer

fields.name: solDepositAuthority
docs: Toggles whether the `DepositSol` instruction requires a signature from
this `sol_deposit_authority`

fields.name: solDepositFee
docs: Fee assessed on SOL deposits

fields.name: solReferralFee
docs: Fees paid out to referrers on referred SOL deposits.
Expressed as a percentage (0 - 100) of SOL deposit fees.
i.e. `sol_deposit_fee`% of SOL deposited is collected as deposit fees
for every deposit and `sol_referral_fee`% of the collected SOL
deposit fees is paid out to the referrer

fields.name: solWithdrawAuthority
docs: Toggles whether the `WithdrawSol` instruction requires a signature from
the `deposit_authority`

fields.name: solWithdrawalFee
docs: Fee assessed on SOL withdrawals

fields.name: nextSolWithdrawalFee
docs: Future SOL withdrawal fee, to be set for the following epoch

fields.name: lastEpochPoolTokenSupply
docs: Last epoch's total pool tokens, used only for APR estimation

fields.name: lastEpochTotalLamports
docs: Last epoch's total lamports, used only for APR estimation

accounts.name: validatorList
docs: Storage list for all validator stake accounts in the pool.

fields.name: accountType
docs: Account type, must be `ValidatorList` currently

fields.name: maxValidators
docs: Maximum allowable number of validators

fields.name: validators
docs: List of stake info for each validator in the pool

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes a new `StakePool`.
0. `[w]` New `StakePool` to create.
1. `[s]` Manager
2. `[]` Staker
3. `[]` Stake pool withdraw authority
4. `[w]` Uninitialized validator stake list storage account

instructions.name: redelegate
docs: (Staker only) Redelegate active stake on a validator, eventually moving
it to another
Internally, this instruction splits a validator stake account into its
corresponding transient stake account, redelegates it to an ephemeral
stake account, then merges that stake into the destination transient
stake account.
In order to rebalance the pool without taking custody, the staker needs
a way of reducing the stake on a stake account. This instruction splits
some amount of stake, up to the total activated stake, from the
canonical validator stake account, into its "transient" stake
account.
The instruction only succeeds if the source transient stake account and
ephemeral stake account do not exist.
The amount of lamports to move must be at least rent-exemption plus the
minimum delegation amount. Rent-exemption plus minimum delegation
is required for the destination ephemeral stake account.
The rent-exemption for the source transient account comes from the stake
pool reserve, if needed.
The amount that arrives at the destination validator in the end is
`redelegate_lamports - rent_exemption` if the destination transient
account does *not* exist, and `redelegate_lamports` if the destination
transient account already exists. The `rent_exemption` is not activated
when creating the destination transient stake account, but if it already
exists, then the full amount is delegated.

transaction is signed by the custodian

docs: epoch height at which this stake will allow withdrawal, unless the
transaction is signed by the custodian

fields.name: custodian
docs: custodian signature on a transaction exempts the operation from
lockup constraints

definedTypes.name: validatorStakeInfo
docs: Information about a validator in the pool
NOTE: ORDER IS VERY IMPORTANT HERE, PLEASE DO NOT RE-ORDER THE FIELDS UNLESS
THERE'S AN EXTREMELY GOOD REASON.
To save on BPF instructions, the serialized bytes are reinterpreted with a
`bytemuck` transmute, which means that this structure cannot have any
undeclared alignment-padding in its representation.

this field may not be accurate

fields.name: transientStakeLamports
docs: Amount of transient stake delegated to this validator
Note that if `last_update_epoch` does not match the current epoch then
this field may not be accurate

fields.name: lastUpdateEpoch
docs: Last epoch the active and transient stake lamports fields were updated

account address

fields.name: status

fields.name: voteAccountAddress
